newsitem.title: USA: Hadco buys Zycon for about $205 mln cash.
newsitem.headline: Hadco buys Zycon for about $205 mln cash.

text.p: Hadco Corp said Thursday that it has agreed to acquire Zycon Corp for about $205 million in cash, or $18.00 per share.

Hadco, an electronic interconnect products supplier based in New Hampshire, said buying the California printed circuit board maker gives it a West Coast presence and positions it "as the largest interconnect circuit producer in the United States and one of the top five manufacturers in the world."
Hadco said Zycon and certain principal shareholders ended a previous agreement to sell Zycon stock at $16.25 per share.
Certain Zycon shareholders owning about 60 percent of the company's outstanding stock have agreed to tender all their shares to Hadco, Hadco said.
